basics.name: Ivan Avdeyev
basics.label: Frontend Developer
basics.summary:
Frontend developer building React and TypeScript interfaces for web and mobile applications. Experience includes a Nuxt 2-to-Astro website migration, reusable page components built with designers, Lighthouse-driven optimization, Next.js migration work, localized product filters, and Storybook components. Developed municipal analytics dashboards and prepared data with SQL and Cube.js. Personal projects explore signal-based UI runtimes, Three.js graphics, OpenWrt theming, and embedded firmware.

projects.name: Treegger
projects.description: Small TypeScript reactive DOM library with HTML templates and a standard automatic JSX runtime, no runtime dependencies, and no virtual DOM.
highlights: Tracks signal dependencies at runtime and updates individual DOM bindings through effects.
Uses nested ownership scopes to dispose child scopes, effects, subscriptions, and cleanup callbacks.
Batches and deduplicates effect jobs through a microtask scheduler.
Provides lazy cached derived values with dependency version checks and configurable result equality.
Implements proxy-based stores with property and membership tracking.
Reconciles keyed lists while preserving DOM node identity for reordered rows.
Supports HTML and SVG, refs, error boundaries, and detached branches that retain DOM state.
Includes behavioral and type tests, CI checks, documentation, and packaged ESM/browser builds.
Experimental proof of concept.
Project ideas and design decisions by the author; code written with help from Codex, as disclosed in the README.
Limitation: No SSR or hydration.
Limitation: JSX requires a standard syntax transform.
Source: https://github.com/eone666/treegger
Source: https://github.com/eone666/treegger/tree/master/src
Source: https://github.com/eone666/treegger/tree/master/test
CV summary: Designed a TypeScript UI runtime with signals, direct DOM updates, keyed lists, and scoped effects. Supports HTML templates and JSX without a framework-specific compiler.
